propertyDetails.description: Set on a corner lot in a picturesque Cambrian neighborhood, this single-story residence blends luxury, convenience, and acclaimed schools (Oster/Dartmouth/Branham). The open layout and remodeled kitchen highlight the modern allure of the home, while soaring vaulted ceilings and large windows create a distinct first impression as you enter. The free-flowing layout connects living, dining, and kitchen areas seamlessly. The living room features a floor-to-ceiling fireplace and opens to a serene backyard with a pool, spa, & covered patio. The gourmet kitchen boasts shaker cabinets, quartz countertops & backsplash, and stainless steel appliances, including an LG ThinQ smart refrigerator, Frigidaire gas range, & double ovens. The spacious primary suite offers a walk-in closet, private access to the backyard, & spa-like ensuite with a custom jacuzzi, standing shower, & dual vanities. Two additional bedrooms, an updated hallway bathroom, & a dedicated laundry space add to the home's functionality. Additional upgrades include copper plumbing, leased solar, and central heat/AC. Conveniently located near Almaden Plaza, Oakridge Mall, Downtown Willow Glen, Los Gatos, & the Pruneyard, with easy access to VTA and highways 85 & 87. Top schools: Oster/Dartmouth/Branham (buyer to verify).
